🛠️ Embedded Setup & Hardware Reference

⚡ Quick Deploy Guide (Vercel + ESP32)

  1. Upload the firmware in src/main.cpp to your ESP32-CAM via PlatformIO / Arduino IDE.
  2. Connect your ESP32-CAM to your Wi-Fi network and note down its assigned IP address from the Serial Monitor.
  3. Enter your ESP32-CAM local IP address or public URL in the Device Address field at the top right of this page and click Connect.
  4. If hosting this site on Vercel (HTTPS) while your ESP32 is on HTTP, ensure CORS is enabled on the device or use a proxy tunnel like Ngrok for remote access.
